meta.name: debugger
meta.description: Activate when any GTM-OS CLI command fails with an error. Also triggers on: 'debug', 'fix', 'not working', 'broken', 'troubleshoot', 'help me fix', 'what went wrong', 'why is this failing', or any variant indicating something is broken.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断并修复GTM-OS CLI命令的运行时错误
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常使用GTM-OS CLI并遇到命令执行失败
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix runtime errors in GTM-OS CLI commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use GTM-OS CLI and encounter command failures

howto.what: 当 GTM-OS 命令出错或你提到“调试”等词时，Claude 会自动执行 5 层诊断，从检查环境变量、数据库、配置文件到测试 API，找出错误原因，给出修复建议并等你批准。修复后还会重新运行原命令确认成功。
howto.when: 当你运行任何 `pnpm cli --` 命令并看到错误或堆栈信息时，或者当你说出“debug”、“fix”、“not working”等关键词，或者粘贴来自 GTM-OS 的错误信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我调试这个命令为什么失败。
say.note: Claude 会从环境检查开始逐层诊断。

say.text: 修复未配置文件的问题。

say.note: Claude 会识别涉及的提供商并运行针对性检查。

howto.what_en: When a GTM-OS command fails or you mention debugging, Claude runs a 5-layer diagnostic funnel (env, database, config, API, deep logic) to find the root cause, suggests a fix, and re-runs the command after approval.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any GTM-OS CLI error, or when user says 'debug', 'fix', 'not working', 'broken', 'troubleshoot', 'help me fix', 'what went wrong', 'why is this failing', or pastes an error message from GTM-OS.

say_en.text: Help me debug why this command failed.
say_en.note: Claude starts from environment validation and proceeds layer by layer.
Claude checks .env.local and offers auto-fix for common issues.
Claude identifies the provider and runs targeted checks.
